title: Replace header logo with the user-provided uploaded logo

requirements.text: Update the header logo image element at XPath /html[1]/body[1]/div[1]/div[1]/header[1]/div[1]/div[1]/a[1]/img[1] to use the user-uploaded logo (file_00000000c9f87209a233972db5aad76c-3.png) as its image source, and ensure no other (incorrect) logo assets are used for this header logo.

quotes: This is not given by me I gave you another and used another is not a part of my project please this logo

acceptanceCriteria: The header logo at the specified XPath renders using the newly uploaded image file_00000000c9f87209a233972db5aad76c-3.png (served as a static asset under frontend/public/assets/generated).
The header no longer references the previously used/incorrect uploaded logo asset.
The footer logo remains unchanged (continues using frontend/src/components/marketing/logo.ts LOGO_SRC).
Header logo retains existing sizing (h-12 w-12) and existing error handling behavior (onError hides the image).

constraints: Frontend immutable paths must not be edited: frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/components/ui.
Do not change the footer logo implementation (Footer should continue using LOGO_SRC/LOGO_ALT).
Backend is single-actor; no backend changes are required for this logo fix.
nonGoals: Redesigning the site theme or layout.
Changing brand name text in the header/footer.

required: Round eco-themed badge logo with sugarcane stalks, a plate, sunrise, soil and green leaves, and the text 'ZeroPlast Crew' (header-logo-uploaded-v2.dim_1024x1024.png)
